what_it_is.prose: Digantara is a Bengaluru-based spacetech startup founded in 2018, specialising in space situational awareness (SSA), space surveillance and intelligence. Made history on 14 January 2025 with the launch of SCOT (Space Camera for Object Tracking) — India's first homegrown space surveillance satellite — aboard SpaceX Falcon 9 Transporter-12. SCOT commissioned as world's first commercial space surveillance satellite on 8 March 2025 (began ops capturing images over South America). Raised $50M Series B (Dec 2025) led by Reliance Business Ventures — total funding ~$66.5M. Plans to expand from space surveillance into space-based missile defense (prototype missile-tracking satellite in 18 months). Partnered with Singapore's DSTA for SSA co-development (Feb 2026). Plans 8 CubeSats in first phase of LEO constellation. Selected by World Economic Forum.
